prompt: A high-precision commercial-grade wrist roller device constructed entirely from industrial-grade materials with a focus on functional simplicity and durability. The primary structure consists of a straight 32mm diameter aluminum alloy handle bar with a fully knurled surface texture for enhanced grip, featuring a matte black anodized finish. The handle extends horizontally with symmetrical 120mm length from center to each end, maintaining a rigid straight profile without any curvature or ergonomic bends. At the center of the handle, a 200mm long nylon webbing strap is securely stitched to a reinforced aluminum D-ring, suspended vertically downward. The strap terminates in a precision-machined Olympic weight loading pin with a 28mm diameter, designed to accept standard 25mm Olympic weight plates. A single 10kg black rubber-coated weight plate is attached to the pin, hanging freely with a 150mm vertical drop from the strap's attachment point. All metal components exhibit a restrained brushed steel finish with no surface branding, while the strap and weight plate feature matte black synthetic materials. The device lacks any additional pads, handles, or support structures beyond the specified components. The visual design strictly avoids any resemblance to barbells, EZ bars, dumbbells, or weight racks, with no curved elements, text, logos, or mechanical redundancies. The product is photographed in a front three-quarter view at a 35-degree angle, with the camera positioned at the mid-height of the device's vertical axis. The entire object is captured within the frame with generous white space margins, against a seamless pure white background. The lighting is soft diffused studio illumination with no harsh shadows, creating a subtle contact shadow beneath the device. All surfaces remain unbranded, with no visible trademarks, labels, or text. The color palette adheres to matte black and graphite finishes on metal components, with restrained brushed steel accents and black synthetic materials on the strap and weight plate. The image excludes any persons, body parts, rooms, or mechanical elements not explicitly described, ensuring strict compliance with the specified prohibitions.
